_comment: Sanitized example of the runtime configuration this app consumes. Values shown are placeholders only — never put real credentials here. Secrets belong in the Gcore Secrets Manager; the FE_* variables below are set as FastEdge environment variables on the application.

secrets_via_gcore_secrets_manager.SESSION_SIGNING_KEY: <32+ bytes of entropy, e.g. output of scripts/generate_admin_credentials.py --session-key>
secrets_via_gcore_secrets_manager.APP_TOKEN_SIGNING_KEY: <32+ bytes of entropy, different from SESSION_SIGNING_KEY>
secrets_via_gcore_secrets_manager.GCORE_API_KEY: <Gcore permanent API token with FastEdge permissions>
